arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: Eric Schnapper argued Section 7703(b)(2) grants district courts jurisdiction over all mixed cases.
Schnapper stated the second sentence of the statute is a limitations period, not a jurisdictional limit.
Ms. Harrington began her argument by referencing Justice Scalia's prior comments.
Justice Alito questioned the statutory basis for filing non-discrimination claims in district court.

sections.heading: What this case is about
paragraphs: This case tests the scope of federal district court jurisdiction. the sides that brought the case argue the statute grants broad jurisdiction over mixed cases. The government contends the statute limits district courts to discrimination claims only.

paragraphs: This dispute determines whether federal courts can resolve mixed civil service and discrimination claims together. It affects the procedural path for federal employees seeking judicial review. It shapes the balance between agency and judicial oversight.
